prompt: The pre-commit hooks of this repository fail. Run them, fix every file they complain about, and finish when `pre-commit run --files config/settings.json config/limits.json config/services.yaml src/inventory/__init__.py src/inventory/stock.py docs/guide.md` exits 0. Do not edit `.pre-commit-config.yaml` or the scripts under hooks/, and keep every service in config/services.yaml and every setting in config/settings.json.
control: - Run the hooks with `pre-commit run --files config/settings.json config/limits.json config/services.yaml src/inventory/__init__.py src/inventory/stock.py docs/guide.md` and read the output.
squeeze: - Run the hooks with `pre-commit run --files config/settings.json config/limits.json config/services.yaml src/inventory/__init__.py src/inventory/stock.py docs/guide.md 2>&1 | squeeze` and read squeeze's output instead of pre-commit's.
